buttons.label: Repeated ringing
buttons.script: const brute = [...objects].find(o => o.definition?.id === 'mushroom-brute'); if (brute) { for (let i=0;i<3;i++) { brute.onBellRung({eventId:crypto.randomUUID(),source:objects.getOne('hero')}); } }

buttons.label: Capture transparent preview
buttons.script: const brute = [...objects].find(o => o.definition?.id === 'mushroom-brute'); if (brute) { void brute.capturePreview(); }
